note: Designated roadside camping on Haystack Road (Forest Road 304), which leaves US-3 by the Beaver Brook picnic area south of Twin Mountain and runs to the Little River and the North Twin trailhead. Numbered, wooded drive-in sites with fire pits; no trash service. Up to 3 vehicles and 15 people a site. The road is gated in winter (it opened May 20 in 2026). Sites are short and rustic; a 23-ft rig fits but check the site before pulling in. --Claude
